parts.text: A student investigates the image produced by a lens. Figure 3.1 Figure 3.2

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Measure the height h O of the illuminated object in Figure 3.2. Give your answer in centimetres to the nearest millimetre. Include the unit. h O = ....................................... unit .......... [2]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The student: • places the lens a distance U = 20.0 cm from the illuminated object • adjusts the position of the screen until a focused image is formed on the screen.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) On Figure 3.1, measure the distance v between the centre of the lens and the screen. v = .................................................... cm [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The diagram is 1 5 th actual size. Calculate the actual distance V between the centre of the lens and the screen. V = .................................................... cm [1]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) The student measures the height h 1 of the image on the screen. h 1 = ............................................................... 3.3 cm Calculate the magnification m 1 using the equation: m 1 = h 1 h O . Give your answer to a suitable number of significant figures for this experiment. m 1 = ......................................................... [1]

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) The student: • moves the lens to a distance V from the illuminated object • adjusts the position of the screen until a focused image is formed on the screen • measures the height h 2 of the image. h 2 = ............................................................... Calculate the magnification m 2 using the equation: m 2 = h 2 h O . Give your answer to a suitable number of significant figures for this experiment. m 2 = ......................................................... [2] 0.6 cm
